text: Legionnaires, to arms!
I do not get paid enough for this..
My comrades will avenge my death.
coughs blood.
This is no victory for you.
I am going to slap the dumb right out of you.
Did you hear that?
Prepare your mind for eternity.
Defend the Heart!
I hope those bloodstains never come out!
Woe unto you.
I think I will take your ears as a trophy.
raises its claws in fury!
falls lifelessly to the ground.
Let my spirit soar on the winds.
moves toward you in anger.
growls and leaps to attack.
ceases to move.
Two portions, two portions of three!  The third to you, our master, we give to thee!
tastes the air, it seems to sense an intruder.
spreads its hood and strikes at you.
sprays black slime from its wounds and mouth!
How...did...ugh...
falls in a pool of black blood.
beneath you begins to open up.
flies forward, gnashing its teeth.
My death means nothing, you shall not succeed.
explodes into sticky strands of viscous matter!
turns towards you suddenly and begins to attack.
I will be reborn again, and you will die!
cries out, 'You shall be turned into dust!'
Flowing ceremonial robes fall to the ground as the servitor ceases to attack.
slumps to its knees, coughing green blood all over your armor. It then falls forward, dead at your feet.
Your name shall be added to the most wanted list of the Freeport Militia!!
You narrowly escape as a pungent smelling rodent lunges at you.
You wipe bits of goo from yourself as the creature dies at your feet.
smiles at you, happy to be released from its pain.
The murky ground bubbles as it attacks.
stops bubbling as it falls dead.
stills and sinks into the wet ground.
You leave, this Bubonian land!
swipes at you, in protection of the Crypt.
There must be hundreds of interlopers in this place of nature, and this one has just crossed paths with terrible fate!
Death has found me at last.
I will collect your soul for my lord.
The menacing voice is heard once again saying, 'Betrayer and desecrator of storms I call upon you to end the lives of those fools.'
Mine will be the greatest story of all, are you prepared to play your part?

Dead silence reigns throughout the crypt as the heroes stand victorious over the High Priests lifeless body. Moments later a soft almost inaudible voice echoes through your mind whispering, 'Free us you must.' Then a wretched creatures appears out of nowhere shaking and muttering gibberish.
falls to the ground in a pile of feathers and broken bones.
Hardly a worthy adversary.  A member of the Indigo Brotherhood deserves a much better opponent.
collapses to form a pile of fur and gore.
moves into battle, joints squealing
Quick! An intruder is trying to let the beast free!
falls lifelessly to the ground.
Leave at once! Before there is bloodshed.
falls to the ground letting out a pathetic croak.
becomes mobile and lurches at you with its sharp spines.
Unbelievable. . . I. . . Ugh. . .
Froak! Froak!
You will know true power, fool!
stops clicking and falls to the ground.
comes to life and attacks.
clicks its wings at you. 'None are allowed audience with the master, you will die here.'
Searing pain shall be yours.
seems to be locked in momentary agony as death comes upon it.
attempts to eviscerate you with its tongue.
squeaks and squeals as it lays lifeless.
begins to attack you, obviously surprised by your presence.
bark, bark, bark!!!
spits with guttural hiss as it slithers toward its victim.
utters a hiss that trails into the wind as its life expires.
You dare defile this sacred place? You are no better than they . . .
swoops at its foe.
bones rattle as it charges with a vengeance.
falls to the ground silently and emotionless.
skitters towards you.
topples into the muck-water.
wipes its maw with a bloody hand as it charges you.
rears its head back and charges!
I hope you prove more of a challenge than the last.
grunts in defeat as it slumps to the ground.
blinks and the black glare of its eye goes dull as he tumbles to the ground.
The Defender of Righteousness can no longer fulfill its duty to the sanctuary. You are closing ever-nearer to your final destination.
Witness the wrath of the Legion of Mata Muram.
continues to twitch long after its death.
motions towards you before attacking!
roars, 'Mortals, here? I will torch you alive for this atrocity!'
Noooo. . . fear. . . shall never die. . .
Nooooo, I was not finished with you yet!
hisses and strikes.
swivels with malice toward its unwary opponent.
shudders on the ground and falls still.
radiates tendrils of grounded electricity as its body dissipates into nothingness.
menacingly raises a heavy fist as it senses an enemy.
collapses into a pile of crumbled stone.
's corpse falls dead, collapsing on her tattered wings.
spreads her wings, preparing for battle.
Leave it to the living infidels to trifle with necromantic supremacy!
The eyes of the beast glow a bright red, a sense of corroding life burns in your mind.
Death comes your way foolish one.
smirks and shakes his head.  'That's what you get for messing with the Freeport Militia!!'
drops to the ground, its eyes dimming to dull orbs.
crouches and pounces at its victim.
There is no place to hide for one who slays an arcane scientist.
corpse bleeds across the ground.
keels over, its lithe body broken.
Draw your weapons. I want this to last.
You lack a sense of patience, for this failure there is but only one punishment.
's corpse cries out as he falls to the ground. His obsidian scimitar clangs against the floor of Drunder and shatters into a thousand pieces.
's corpse mumbles a fading, final prayer.
rushes towards you with its fangs bared.
rises off its haunches with its claws outstretched.
I will stretch your flayed skin over a drum and craft your bones into instruments of music!
The banshee opens her fetid mouth and a painful song assails your ears.
I LIVE! Prepare yourselves, mortals. You will bow before the terrible might of the Prince of Hate!
I can no longer sit idly by, Innoruuk. These pathetic wretches will die by my hand as well.
's corpse shouts, 'No, it cannot end like this!
's corpse says, 'Every man's time comes.'
The King's ice sphere explodes into a cloud of glittering shards.
's corpse falls, as an earthquake loosens the foundation of Riftseeker's Sanctum
rushes forward to protect its treasure.
Out!  Out!  OUT!  You be makin' a fine mess of me baths!  Get outta here before I make a nice meal o' you!
collapses into a broken heap.
Wikiwikiwiki!
Prepare to die!
NOOO!
You have chosen opponents most unwisely, I am at utmost power in this place!
charges ahead with a dreadful fury.
makes the ground shake with deadly intent.
Pargh!  Lynuga not like you!  Lynuga squish you!
Rrrrrr.. I rrremove you from ourrr peaceful island!
Guards!  Come smash!
shatters as it hits the ground, its bones scattered.
shudders and collapses.
scuttles from the shadows.
falls to the ground dead, although its legs continue to twitch.
falls to the ground with a pathetic screech.
My comrades will avenge my death.
You have run me through!  Beware the Pirates of Gunthak.. They will avenge me... Unngh!!
Hail. traveler!  It is good to see new faces in our fishing village.  I am Brenzl McMannus.  I am quite talented with wood and string.  I sell the finest nets and bows in the land. Have a glance.
Arrrhhh..  The Merchants of Qeynos.. are many.. and powerful.. ..you won't get away.. with.. this.. hor.. orr.. rible.. .. ..
Invade our home, kill our young?  It is on a spike your head will be hung!
I tried my best, yet now I am dead.  It looks as if you will keep your head.
You invade my realm, and you kill my vassals!  For that I shall strip your flesh, and wear it as tassels.
Hail.. Prime.. Healer!!
For the glory of Kaladim, have at thee!!
Grrrr...fool, you shall soon regret trespassing in the tunnels of our ancestors!
Royal guards of Icewell Keep to my aid!!  Someone is trying to breach the forbidden door!
Your days have come to an end!!
One has been engaged, it will exterminate the intruders.
This one's death has been requisitioned, another is needed.
Your presence here is sacrilege!  You will feel the power that dragon kin wields!
Welcome to pain, the second of three.  You have dealt with the first one, now you deal with me.
Dare ye defy the pirates of gunthak?!
My comrades will avenge my death.
You chose to attack the Vah Shir and so you chose to die.
hisses threateningly filling the air with the stench of moldy decay.
ceases fighting, a puzzled look on its face
Ha ha!!  Fool..  The Crusaders of Greenmist shall torture you to death!!  Ha ha!!
I will gut you like a fish when I am done.
Finally, the pain ends....
Nooo, who will take care of the mushrooooms?

Mooto na!  I show ya tha power of Tarmok!

I knew we should have watched you closer.
Guards!  Guards!

I'll hack at your knees 'till you fall down!  Out of love for the Dain, for the glory of the crown!
